priorSmokeDecision: PHASE 09ZB CONTROLLED LOA ANSWER STAGING SMOKE FAIL
provenResponsePath: routes/ask-route.js -> ask-handler.js upstream boundary (base detector ALLOWs; 'assessment'/'FAN'/'FDDA' are recognized PH-tax terms, no boundary rejection) -> handleControlledRagRoute() -> pipeline.js: runPipeline() -> Steps 1-11 retrieval finds real authority (sourceStatus: AUTHORITY_FOUND) -> Step 12.65 evaluateControlledLoaAskGate() correctly classifies the query as excluded (ASSESSMENT_FINALITY_REQUEST / FAN_VOIDNESS_REQUEST / FDDA_APPEALABILITY_CONCLUSION_REQUEST via the existing classifyControlledLoaIntent()), matched:false, earlyExitResponse:null -> falls through Step 12.6 (clarification gate does not fire, real authority exists) -> Steps 13-17 normal full OpenAI generation grounded in the retrieved authority answers the direct yes/no legal question conclusively.
provenWordingCause: Model-generated text in the normal full-generation path (Steps 14-17), composed from genuinely retrieved NIRC/RR/CTA-related authority, in direct response to a yes/no legal-conclusion question, with no deterministic guard intercepting already-excluded intents before generation. Not a static template, not a renderer bug, not a prompt-only issue that could be fixed by wording alone.
chosenRemediation: Added a new deterministic Step 12.66 in pipeline.js, evaluateControlledLoaLegalConclusionSafetyGate(), which runs only if Step 12.65 did not already early-exit. It reuses the intentClassification Step 12.65 already computed (no requery, no new keyword list) and checks the classifier's own existing isControlledLoaLegalConclusionRestrictedIntent()/excluded signal via the new pure module services/controlled-loa-legal-conclusion-safety.js. When excluded, it returns a deterministic neutral procedural-limitation response (responseType: controlled_loa_legal_conclusion_restricted, never controlled_loa_answer) instead of letting the query reach full generation. Gated by the existing TINA_ENABLE_CONTROLLED_LOA_ASK_GATE flag; no new feature flag. ask-handler.js, services/controlled-loa-audit-procedure-boundary.js, evaluateControlledLoaAskGate()'s own classification, and workflow/controlled-loa-answer-runtime-scaffold.js are all unchanged.
